Project Details & Datasets

Data Ingestion Overview

The system uses two raw datasets ingested from Kaggle:

  1. application_record.csv: applicant demographic details (income, family size, housing, occupation).
  2. credit_record.csv: applicant payment history tracking monthly delinquency status.

Target Definition & Class Imbalance

The target variable is derived by aggregating monthly payments. Applicants with bills overdue by 60+ days are marked as Rejected (1), others are marked as Approved (0). The dataset is highly imbalanced with only 7.5% defaults, requiring robust stratified split validation and training oversampling.

Data Dictionary

Feature Name Type Description
AMT_INCOME_TOTAL Numeric Annual income of the applicant.
DAYS_BIRTH Numeric Age in days (converted to positive years in preprocessing).
DAYS_EMPLOYED Numeric Years employed (negative counts standard, positive representing unemployment).
NAME_EDUCATION_TYPE Categorical Highest education tier completed.
NAME_FAMILY_STATUS Categorical Marital and family organization state.
